name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Kitchen orders for food trucks
promotionalText: Receive pre-orders, protect your kitchen from excess orders, and continue service when the signal cuts out. The ordering app for food truck teams.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, then mark them as ready and then as collected.

■ Don't promise a time you can't commit to
Set how much your kitchen can cook at one time and how long that takes. When a collection time is full, customers can't choose it, so the order queue matches the kitchen's capacity.

■ Take orders at the hatch
Add in-person (walk-up) orders on the same screen where pre-orders appear, so the kitchen works from one queue.

■ One screen for the kitchen
The kitchen screen shows what needs preparing now, what's next, and what's ready, with an alert when it's time to start preparing an order.

■ Print order tickets
Connect the kitchen receipt printer via Bluetooth or via your local network, and order tickets will print automatically.

■ Continue service when the signal cuts out
Activate order protection for when the connection drops; if the connection drops, pre-orders pause temporarily so nobody sends an order you won't see. Orders you receive on the device are saved and synced when the connection returns.

■ Designed for working in the truck
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen lit during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app using Face ID or Touch ID.

■ Plan your week
Set up your events and locations once, and receive orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is intended for food truck operators and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
